description: This file contains setup procedures for retail items and their prices in an ERPNext demo environment. It defines functions to load item data from a JSON file, update item defaults with company and warehouse information, and populate item prices for different price lists.

methods.name: setup_data()
methods.description: Main function to set up items and item prices, then commit and clear cache.

methods.name: setup_item()
methods.description: Loads item data from a JSON file, creates item documents, updates warehouse defaults based on domain data, and inserts the items into the database.

methods.name: setup_item_price()
methods.description: Deletes existing item prices and assigns new prices for specified items under different price lists.
